title: FUMI Fiery Mango Nicotine Pouches - 8mg per Pouch
description: FUMi Fiery Mango Strong Nicotine Pouches pair the ripe sweetness of Mango with a subtle Chilli warmth, creating a pouch with smooth tropical flavour and added depth. The Chilli doesn’t dominate—it simply enhances the fruit with a mellow contrast. Each slim, all-white pouch sits discreetly under the lip and delivers a gradual release of flavour and 8mg of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With no smoke, vapour or lingering odour, they’re ideal for convenient, on-the-go use. Each can includes 20 plant-fibre pouches, produced to high standards in Sweden by Helix AB. Nicotine Range: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users. How to Use: Nicotine Pouches PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
